answer: Require each agent identity to lock a non-refundable deposit proportional to its transaction volume, like a dune holding back sand — spinning up thousands of fake identities gets expensive fast. Before trading, every newcomer must also pass a fresh human-verified task, such as reciting a one-time signed sonnet, and only then may it wander into the marketplace. Honest agents recover their deposit and earn fees; attackers burn stake on useless identities, so sybil swarms stay unprofitable by design.
